# Creation: The Art of Substantial Thought

To cast *Creation* is to perform the ultimate alchemy: transmuting nothingness into substance through sheer force of will. 

### Manifestation and the Weave
The spell begins as a prismatic distortion in the air, similar to heat rising from a sun-baked road. Wisps of shadow and silver light twine together, spinning with increasing velocity until they snap into the rigid geometry of matter. To the caster, the Weave feels unnervingly heavy—not the fluid grace of a fireball, but the laborious pull of a loom. One must drag the raw quintessence of the Astral Plane into the material realm, a sensation akin to pulling silk through thick honey. The air grows dense, smelling of ozone and fresh-turned earth, as the object solidifies.

### The Legend of Valerius
Lore attributes this discovery to the Archmage Valerius the Lonesome. Trapped within a barren, anti-magic cell, Valerius spent decades tracing the "hollows" between stars. He realized that existence is merely a persistent thought. With a final, focused breath, he did not pick his lock; he imagined a key so vividly that the universe had no choice but to provide it.
